appearances.title: Two DGX Sparks on one cable: listing both NCCL_IB_HCA devices lifts long-prompt processing 26-28%
appearances.summary: Each Spark port shows up as two network devices and using one gets about 112 of 200 Gb/s; naming both in NCCL_IB_HCA speeds prompt processing 26-28% with generation unchanged. The fix is merged into TensorFold's docs via the linked pull request.

appearances.title: TensorFold 1.2.9 multiplies local multi-stream decode
appearances.summary: TensorFold 1.2.9 adds an Ollama-compatible API, TOML serve configs, and better logprobs, and fixes Nemotron image requests and a GLM prompt-logprob hang. On an M5 Ultra, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning MLX 4-bit without an MTP head delivered 3.2 to 3.5 times the combined decode throughput across 24 streams, with the same reply tokens.

appearances.title: TensorFold 1.2.8 adds Flint, DeepSeek-V4.1 on Metal, and faster prefill
appearances.summary: TensorFold 1.2.8 adds Recursive Flint 40B-A2.5B on M5 Macs, experimental DeepSeek-V4.1 on Metal, Qwen3 embeddings and rerankers on CUDA, and page-image OCR on HIP. Qwen3.8-27B MLX 8-bit cold prompts are about 33% faster on an M5 Ultra, and Flash Next CUDA prefill at TP=2 is about 27% to 34% faster.

appearances.title: TensorFold 1.2.4: 319K-token DeepSeek-V4.1 conversation restored from NVMe in about 1.3 s on two GB10s
appearances.summary: The local inference engine's new release restores a saved 319K-token DeepSeek-V4.1 session from disk in 1.2 to 1.4 s instead of 155 to 178 s on two GB10 (DGX Spark class) boxes, and cuts a two-client Flash Next MLX test on M5 Ultra from 127 s to 47 s. It also adds Gemma 4 E4B on CUDA, LFM3-1.7B on Metal, and HIP builds on Windows; a separate preview shows Qwen 3.8 27B NVFP4 at about 220 tok/s deco

appearances.title: TensorFold runs on Apple M1 GPUs under Linux via a Vulkan backend, 41% faster per token
appearances.summary: A contributor got TensorFold inference running on an M1 Max GPU under Linux through a Vulkan backend, cutting per-token latency from 160 ms to 94 ms with byte-identical output. The work is an in-progress PR, not yet merged.
